source: Print titles: the book and series titles set in italics on janjohnsonprints.com, 2026-10-25, marked with asterisks; “La defense” corrected to “La défense”; and five titles that had their catalogue entry (medium, references, notes) run on at the end cut back to the title, with “Salvator Rose” corrected to “Rosa” and one watermark moved to its own field.
note: Each change applies only while the field still reads exactly as before (a title may be listed both as imported and as already marked), so edits made in the admin pages are kept.
